Material.description: A material: a name to choose. Its values are the tools' rows for it.

name.description: The material's name, unique in the library (upper or lower case don't matter).

uid.description:
What projects and the tools' rows name the material by: 16 lowercase hex digits,
never changed.

description: Schema version 3. Older files load through Chipload's migrations; this schema describes only the current version.

default_material.description: The name of the material new projects start with. Null: none.

default_thickness.description: The stock thickness new projects start with, mm. Left out: 10 mm.

schema_version.description: The version of the file format. Chipload upgrades older files when it reads them, and refuses newer ones.

written_by.description: The Chipload version that wrote the file.

title: Chipload materials
